extensionName.message: FX Pulse — exchange rates at hand

extensionDescription.message: Login-free market quotes, trends, official references and conversion across major currencies.

refreshHint.message: Refresh reloads stored backend data; it does not trigger a new provider collection.

converterHint.message: Uses market midpoints when available; otherwise an official daily reference with source and date. Fees and spreads excluded.

midpointDisclaimer.message: The midpoint averages bid and ask prices. It is not the official RMB fixing or a bank transaction rate. For reference only.

copyManual.message: Automatic copy failed. Press Ctrl/Cmd+C to copy.

amountRange.message: Enter a valid amount from 0 to 1 trillion

officialUnavailable.message: Reference rates unavailable. Please refresh later.

officialDaily.message: Daily reference · Not a bank transaction rate

tooManyRequests.message: Too many requests. Try again later.

cannotConnect.message: Unable to connect to the server

checkBackend.message: Unable to connect to the server. Check the backend address and connection.

settingsIntro.message: No account required. Your watchlist, targets and conversion preferences stay in this browser. The backend retrieves and caches public exchange rates.

privacyBody.message: The extension never sends email. Targets are compared when you open it; with alerts enabled, background checks read only already-cached backend data and never reach the upstream provider. The backend protects provider keys and reduces duplicate requests.

serverPermissionDenied.message: Permission to access this server was denied

invalidUrl.message: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS address

hoverDescription.message: Hover and toolbar share the backend, quote cache, language and watchlist. No userscript manager is needed. Amounts are detected locally; page content is not uploaded. Disable the old userscript to avoid duplicate cards.

hoverPermissionDenied.message: Website permission denied. Hover remains off.

hoverEnabledMessage.message: Enabled. Reload your web pages to use it.

hoverFailed.message: Could not configure hover. Reload the extension.

alertsDescription.message: Alerts read already-cached backend data and never spend provider quota.

alertsPermissionDenied.message: Notification permission denied. Alerts stay off.

alertsFailed.message: Could not configure alerts. Reload the extension.

hoverUnavailable.message: Quotes unavailable. Check the backend connection.

hoverUnsupported.message: Currency not configured or not collected yet

hoverGuessed.message: Currency detected automatically; adjust if needed

hoverManual.message: Automatic copy failed. Copy the selected text.

hoverOfficial.message: Official reference · daily · not a dealing rate

converterNoRate.message: No rate available: collection may be pending, or current data cannot connect these currencies.

bridgeDescription.message: Only needed if you still run the legacy FX Pulse userscript. While it is on, sites you allowed hover on can read cached public quote data, detect that the extension is installed, and make the extension's own hover card stand down once per page. The backend address, preferences and keys are never exposed to a page.

bridgeEnable.message: Let in-page userscripts read this extension's data

bridgeOn.message: Userscript compatibility enabled. Reload your pages.

noMarketHistory.message: No market history is collected for this pair. Conversion may use dated official reference rates.

displayRoundingHint.message: Displayed rates are rounded. Conversion uses full precision; amounts are rounded to two decimal places.

simpleHint.message: Midpoint and converter only. Bid/ask, official references and trends are under details.
